newsitem.title: USA: Columbia Banking files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Columbia Banking files for offering.

text.p: Columbia Banking System Inc said it filed a registration statement, effective upon filing, with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of an additional 185,000 shares, plus 27,750 to cover over-allotments, if any.

As previously announced, Columbia Banking filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1,100,000 shares of common stock (plus 165,000 shares to cover over-allotments, if any). That Registration Statement was declared effective on November 8, 1996.
